# security-audit-mcp

> An MCP server that gives AI agents the ability to run structured security audits based on OWASP Top 10, NIST SP 800-53, and ISO 27001 frameworks.

## What it does

- Provides 6 MCP tools for AI-powered security auditing
- Supports OWASP Top 10 (2021), NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, ISO 27001:2022
- Generates audit reports in JSON, Markdown, and HTML formats
- Enables AI agents to search controls, record audit results, and produce compliance reports
- Zero config — works instantly with `npx security-audit-mcp`

## Installation

Add to Claude Desktop config (`~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`):
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "security-audit": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "security-audit-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Or Claude Code CLI:
```bash
claude mcp add security-audit -- npx -y security-audit-mcp
```

## Available Tools

- `list_frameworks` — list all available security frameworks
- `get_framework` — get full checklist (owasp / nist / iso27001)
- `audit_item` — record pass/fail/skip for a control item
- `generate_report` — generate audit report (json/markdown/html)
- `get_risk_summary` — get risk breakdown by severity
- `search_controls` — search controls by keyword across frameworks
